params.body:
Follow-up on #443 after Shane looked at the deployed list.

## Actions always visible
- **Bidding rows**: "Toon aan klant" (secondary) and "Biedingen" (primary) side by side on desktop; on the phone card "Bekijk biedingen" full width first, "Toon aan klant" under it next to the ⋯ button. "Toon aan klant" is no longer buried in the ⋯ menu.
- **"Enkel overnamedocumenten" rows**: the price is agreed and printing is the work, so the two prints are the buttons ("Overeenkomst", "Borderel" primary) and "Toon aan klant" is not offered. Kopiëren / Aanpassen / Verwijderen stay in ⋯ (plus the prints on bidding rows).

## How long it still runs
Next to the status badge in Looptijd (and as the line under the title on the phone card): open → "nog 5 dagen", "laatste dag" on the end day; closed within the assignment window → "nog 10 dagen om toe te wijzen" (`winnerDaysLeft`, inclusive as of PR 435); assigned or past the window → the badge alone. `ExportVehicle::windowHint()`, keys in nl/fr/en/de/es (`ui.bidding_days_to_go`, `ui.bidding_last_day`, `ui.bidding_days_to_assign`, `ui.bidding_agreement`, `ui.bidding_borderel`). Dates stay as the quiet second line.

## Page lead
`.ui-page-lead` gets `max-width: 90ch` from 1024 px (70ch stays below): the two sentences under "Mijn aangeboden wagens" now take two lines at 1440 instead of three. The other two users of the class (settings/location and release_notes headers) use it as the flex wrapper of way-back + title; a wider cap changes nothing there.

Also: the primary button in the row had invisible text (the list paints links blue on blue); fixed with a scoped colour.

## Tests
`ExportListPhoneCardTest` (5 tests, 65 assertions): both button sets on row and card, the order Biedingen-first on the card, the hints for open / last day / closed-in-window / past-window / assigned. Filter `Export|Bidding|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: 76 tests, 975 assertions, green. Rule B1-1.17 updated.

Screenshots (`scratchpad/shots-bidding-lists-2/`): `exports-after2-nl-1440.png`, `exports-after2-fr-1440.png`, `exports-after-390.png`, `exports-after-390-menu.png`.
params.title: Bidding list: two visible actions per row, how long a bidding still runs, wider page lead
